title: loveee it
text: loveee it. i had a small kcup machine  and i had a roller tray under  i then decided to buy myself a christmas gift and got the hamilton beach flex brew  but i needed this under  it cuz of my cabinets  ...  i was so happy to find that this company made it in a larger size to fit the bigger machine and i didnt see any other LARGE options  so thank you Goldlion !

product_metadata.title: Goldlion Appliance Sliding Tray Compatible with Ninja Grill and KitchenAid Stand Mixer Extra Deep for Keurig Coffee Maker, Instant Pot, Air Fryer and Blender, 11.7 inch Wide by 16.1 inch Deep
features: 【HEAVY MOVEMENT MADE EASY】Moving heavy countertop appliance from underneath cabinet is no longer a hassle but a painless task thanks to our discreetly designed sliding tray with convenient lever control.

【EXTRA LARGE TRAY】Crafted with extra-large surface with a width of 11.7 inch and a depth of 16.1 inch, this tray works with Ninja Grill, KitchenAid Stand Mixer, Keurig Coffee Maker, COSORI Air Fryer, Vitamix Blenders, Instant Pot and more countertop appliances.
【LOW HEIGHT】With a height of merely 0.9 inch, this sliding tray leaves enough space between your cabinet and countertop ensuring hassle-free movement of your taller appliances.
【DURABLE NON-SLIP PAD】Unlike products of competitors with EVA foam surface, Goldlion sliding tray comes with a non-slip surface made of silicone pad for reinforced durability and easy cleaning.
【EASY TO USE】No more moving bothers or scratches to your countertop, place your kitchen appliances on the tray and simply press down the lever to move them back and forth as you wish.
